A_training_admissibility.rule: a coordinate may enter the Epoch-2 search for fold k only if E(c,s,b) <= 0.50 on EVERY D_train(k) discharge/block, using D_train predictors alone
A_training_admissibility.authorised_by: E2.0 section 11A - 'candidates may enter the search only if they satisfy the prospectively frozen training-domain requirement'
A_training_admissibility.interpretation: on the training discharges a coordinate may leave its calibration hull by at most HALF a calibration range, leaving a further half range of headroom before the contractual qualification threshold at tau = 1
A_training_admissibility.why_stricter_than_tau: a coordinate admitted at exactly tau on training has no headroom and is near-certain to breach tau on unseen discharges; the headroom is what makes held-out applicability attainable at all

B_heldout_qualification.rule: after the support is frozen and hashed, apply P-RANGE at tau = 1.0 to every D_test(k) discharge/block
B_heldout_qualification.support_predicate: conjunction - EVERY coordinate must pass on EVERY held-out block
B_heldout_qualification.on_failure_required: record the status; the fold does not qualify for full-domain success; report it

inner_geometry.local_coefficients: discharge x block, calibration-only, as in Epoch 1
